verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਵੜੇਵਾਂ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hoi vaRevaa(n) jag vich beeje tan kheh naal ralaiaa|

en.bdb: The cotton seed got itself mixed with dust.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੂਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਹ ਦੀ ਟੀਂਡੇ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਆਪੁ ਖਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: booTee hoi kapaeh dhee Tee(n)dde has has aap khiRaiaa|

en.bdb: From that very seed the plant of cotton emerged on which the balls smiled unobstructed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਵੇਲਣੁ ਵੇਲਿਆ ਲੂੰ ਲੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਤੁੰਬੁ ਤੁੰਬਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh mil velan veliaa loo(n) loo(n) kar tu(n)b tu(n)baiaa|

en.bdb: The cotton got ginned by the ginning machine and after carding.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਞਣਿ ਪਿੰਞ ਉਡਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋੜੀ ਸੂਤ ਕਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pi(n)n(j)n pi(n)n(j) uddaiaa kar kar goRee soot kataiaa|

en.bdb: Making rolls and spinning, the thread was made from it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਣਿ ਵੁਣਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੁਆਇ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tan vun khu(n)b chaRai kai dhe dhe dhukh dhuaai ra(n)gaiaa|

en.bdb: Then through its warp and waft it was woven and made to suffer getting dyed in boiling cauldron.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੈਚੀ ਕਟਣਿ ਕਟਿਆ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੀਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaichee kaTan kaTiaa sooiee dhaage joR seevaiaa|

en.bdb: The scissors cut it and it was stiched with the help of needle and thread.
Thus it became cloth, the means for the covering up of others' nudity.
